using int64 = long long;
const int64 MOD = 1000000007LL;

class Solver {
    int64 p, k;
    vector<int> seen;

    int64 mod_pow(int64 base, int64 exp) const {
        int64 res = 1;
        base %= p;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if (exp & 1) res = (res * base) % p;
            base = (base * base) % p;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    int64 cycle_factor(int64 len) const {
        if (len == 0) return p;
        return mod_pow(k, len) == 1 ? p : 1;
    }

public:

        cin >> p >> k;

        if (k == 0 || k == 1) {
            int64 ans = 1;
            for (int64 i = 0; i < p - 1; ++i) {
                ans = (ans * p) % MOD;
            }
            if (k == 1) ans = (ans * p) % MOD;
            cout << ans << '\n';
            return;
        }

        seen.assign((size_t)p, 0);
        int64 ans = 1;

        for (int64 i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
            if (seen[i]) continue;
            int64 x = i;
            int64 len = 0;
            while (!seen[x]) {
                seen[x] = 1;
                x = (k * x) % p;
                ++len;
            }
            ans = (ans * cycle_factor(len)) % MOD;
        }

        cout << ans << '\n';
    }
};

    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);

    solver.run();

using ll = long long;

ll p, k;

    for (ll i = 0; i < len; ++i) {

    }

}

    if (k == 0 || k == 1) {

        }
        if (k == 1) ans = (ans * p) % MOD;
        cout << ans << '\n';
        return 0;

    vector<char> seen(p, 0);
    vector<ll> contrib;
    contrib.reserve((size_t)p);

    for (ll start = 1; start < p; ++start) {
        if (seen[start]) continue;
        ll x = start;
        ll len = 0;
        while (!seen[x]) {
            seen[x] = 1;
            x = (k * x) % p;
            ++len;
        }
        contrib.push_back(factor_for_len(len));
